beats.text: Your AI agent just read a poisoned webpage. What happens next depends on five habits.
Think of it as a brilliant intern who believes everything it reads.
One: least privilege. If it only needs to read, don't let it send, pay or delete.
Two: approve anything you can't undo. One tap can stop the whole attack.
Three: keep browsing and work apart. The agent reading random sites shouldn't be logged into your email.
Four: treat unknown files and plugins like email attachments.
Five: check what it hands you. A hijacked agent can just give you a poisoned link.
Five habits. No new software. And an intern that can't hurt you.
